name: feedback
description: The one-shots that answer an action (ADR 0028). useShake() returns a ref and a shake(): three decaying swings, 4 → 2.5 → 1px from --ui-space-xs, over --ui-duration-slow, played once through the Web Animations API and only at Full — the static error cue carries it below. SuccessCheck is the shared Check glyph written in left to right with a clip-path wipe on --ui-duration-slow when it mounts; at Reduced it fades in whole, at Off it is there. Decorative: both sit beside a static cue.
